data.one_liner: Linear progress bar with customizable start, points, and stroke caps
data.what_it_does: Progresso is a Flutter widget that displays a linear progress bar. It supports non‑zero starting values, custom colors, stroke caps, and optional points along the bar.
use_when: Need a simple linear progress bar with custom start value
Want to display markers or points along the progress bar
Require custom stroke caps or colors for the bar
Need a null‑safe, lightweight widget for progress indication
avoid_when: Requiring a circular or radial progress bar
Integrating with state‑management libraries that need custom widgets

alternatives.name: percent_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar linear progress bar with additional styling options and built‑in animation support

data.minimal_example:
Progresso(
  progress: 0.5,
  start: 0.3,
  progressColor: Colors.red,
  backgroundColor: Colors.blue,
  points: [0.2, 0.4],
  progressStrokeCap: StrokeCap.round,
  backgroundStrokeCap: StrokeCap.round,
);
